spec.kitLine: Once: Potency of HP ▲ 30.96% for 5 sec

spec.durationSemantics: 5 s wall-clock (durationSec) — but no schema StatKey exists for heal potency
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter ("when entering Full Burst" = ANY team FB), escalating step 1
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropping the line entirely AND shifting the escalation index — making Distributed Damage the step-1 effect so it fires from the FIRST Full Burst
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Even though this line is unmodeled, the escalating counter must still occupy step 1: assert ZERO buffApply with stat distributedDamagePct between t=0 and the SECOND fullBurstStart event. Red if the encoder collapsed the ladder.
spec.inertness: Toggling this line off via withPatchedOverride must move totals() by exactly 0 (heal amounts are unmodeled; potency has no consumer).

spec.scope: distributedDamagePct — boosts each holder's OWN distributed-flavor hits only, never generic Damage Up
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter, escalating step 2 — first applies on the 2nd FB entry and on every FB thereafter (cumulative "each subsequent triggers all before it")
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two plausible misreads: (a) encoding as attackDamagePct (generic Damage Up) — credits ALL damage of all four units; (b) applying all escalation steps from FB #1
spec.distinguishingAssertion: onEvent: first buffApply with stat===distributedDamagePct value 30.4 occurs at the 2nd fullBurstStart, none at the 1st (red under all-from-first). And with a carry that deals no distributed-flavor damage, totals() must be IDENTICAL with the buff present vs stripped (red under the attackDamagePct misread, which moves every bucket).
spec.inertness: Must move zero damage in any comp with no distributed-flavor dealer; must never touch normal/charge/core buckets.

spec.kitLine: Three times: Stack count of debuffs ▼ 1

spec.nearestWrongModel: Treating "stack count ▼" as a boss-debuff line (an enemy-targeted effect) or, worse, dropping step 3 and re-indexing the ladder
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No enemy-targeted effect and no targetStatus events from skill1; escalation steps 1-2 (esp. the 30.4% distributed buff) STILL apply at the 3rd and later FB entries (cumulative semantics — red under an only-the-Nth-step encoding, which would apply only the cleanse at FB #3).
spec.inertness: Zero board movement; verbatim line must appear in unmodeled.skill1.

spec.scope: heal-over-time — heal AMOUNT is unmodeled but the recovery EVENTS are load-bearing (taxonomy #4: crown's on-recovery consumers sit in the control comp)
spec.durationSemantics: 8 ticks at 1 s interval → heal effect with ticks:8, intervalSec:1 — NOT a single instant recovery event
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter, statically gated by teamHas:{slugs:[same-squad members]} — the owner herself NEVER satisfies her own squad gate
spec.targetSet: allies (all, including self) — every ally receives the recovery events
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropping the squad gate (block fires in every comp) — the HoT then pumps 8 recovery events per FB into crown's "when recovery takes effect" trigger and silently over-credits any comp containing crown; second misread: ticks:1 (one event instead of a sustained 8 s refresh train)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In controlComp (liter/crown/carry/helm — no same-squad ally of this unit): ZERO recovery events sourced from this skill1 block, and crown's recovery-triggered buffApply count is identical with the unit present vs absent. With a same-squad slug patched into the team: exactly 8 recovery events per ally per FB, spaced 1 s (red under ticks:1).

spec.nearestWrongModel: Keying the whole skill2 ladder to fullBurstEnter — every 10 s window then covers the FB (+50%, aura-rich) interval instead of the post-FB downtime, systematically over-crediting all three effects
spec.distinguishingAssertion: onEvent: the first buffApply with stat===hitRatePct value 10.13 carries a timestamp ≥ the first fullBurstEnd event and its window overlaps ZERO frames where inFullBurst===true for the FB that just ended. Red under fullBurstEnter keying.
spec.inertness: No hitRatePct buffApply before the first fullBurstEnd.

skill1: Once: Potency of HP ▲ 30.96% for 5 sec.
Three times: Stack count of debuffs ▼ 1.
burst: Storage: Stores excess healing received by the skill user, up to 60.19% of their Max HP. Lasts for 25 sec.

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads the driver must reconcile: (1) ESCALATION COLLAPSE — both skill1 and skill2 are Liter-style ladders ('each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it'); the two failure shapes are all-steps-from-activation-1 (over-credits the opening ~2 rotations) and only-the-Nth-step (drops earlier steps at later activations). Both must be encoded with the escalating kind, cumulative and capped at 3, and skill1's UNMODELED step 1 must still OCCUPY the ladder index (a no-op step) so the 30.4% distributed buff starts at FB #2. (2) TRIGGER SPLIT — skill1 = fullBurstEnter, skill2 = fullBurstEnd, burst = burstCast; a uniform key on any of the three is wrong, and the skill2-on-enter misread is the highest-damage one (moves all three buffs from post-FB downtime into the +50% FB window). (3) CASTER-ATK SHAPE — both ATK lines say 'of the skill user's ATK' → casterAtkPct flat adds from a supporter's ATK; atkPct would over-credit the carry substantially. (4) TANDEM HEALS — this unit is a heal battery next to crown (control comp): the burst heal is burstCast-gated and the skill1 HoT is same-squad-gated; either gate dropped turns crown's on-recovery consumers into a systematic over-credit. The HoT must be ticks:8/intervalSec:1 (a refresh train), not one event. As a B2 alongside crown, rotation B2-selection determines whether the burst block fires at all — the driver's comp choice for burst-line tests must force her to actually cast. (5) Reload Speed is damage (shot-count gate), never a defensive skip; its 15 s duration differs from the sibling 10 s windows. All magnitudes are kit-literal (DATAMINED); the only ⚑ is the systemic HR→core conversion behind hitRatePct, which is engine-global, not a per-unit guess.
